name: Domain Permissions
description: Replaces Drupal core's access_policy.user_roles service so that a user's non-exempt roles are dynamically stripped on any host that is not the designated edit domain (a host whose name contains the substring '-content'), confining authoring/admin capabilities to the edit domain. Exempt roles are named via the domain_perm_roles_exempt settings override (default anonymous/authenticated). A security-hardening access feature.
project_description:
Useful when your site runs on multiple domains and you want users to have less permissions when running on certain domains. For example, editing might be allowed only on edit.mysite.com and not www.mysite.com 

 See README.md for more information.
